visual_action: A slideshow of three still photos of Donald Trump. The first is a smiling portrait of him in a suit in front of an American flag. The second shows him with a serious expression in a similar setting. The third is an outdoor photo of him on a golf course, wearing a red 'MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN' hat.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is the only person shown in all three photos that comprise the video.

spoken_summary: The video's audio consists solely of a song featuring the lyrics "I was lightning before the thunder," followed by a repeated, bass-heavy "Thunder." There is no dialogue or narration.
audio_music: A dramatic, bass-heavy electronic/pop song (a version of 'Thunder' by Imagine Dragons) plays throughout. The lyrics "I was lightning before the thunder" are sung, followed by a beat drop where the word "Thunder" is repeated with a distorted effect, creating a hype or intense atmosphere.
editing_pacing: A slow-paced slideshow of three static images, with cuts timed to the music.
cultural_references: The song 'Thunder' by Imagine Dragons is used as the soundtrack.
central_claim: The video mocks Donald Trump's self-perception of power by ironically pairing his image with a song about being powerful.
intended_effect: To encourage the viewer to see Donald Trump as ridiculous and mock his self-aggrandizing persona.
